name: progress
title: Progress
description: A bar that shows how far a task has got, with an optional label and formatted value; value={null} is indeterminate.
usage: Use Progress for a task with measurable progress: an export, a large fetch, a memory budget. Pass value and max, or value={null} while the total is unknown. label names the task (and the bar); showValue prints the formatted value (format, getAriaValueText for "412,000 of 1,000,000 rows"). variant shows the outcome: success, warning, danger. For a short unknown wait use Spinner; for loading content with a known shape use Skeleton.

props.name: value
props.description: Progress from min to max; null while indeterminate.

props.name: label
props.description: The task's name above the track; labels the progressbar.

props.name: showValue
props.description: Shows the formatted value at the end of the label line.

props.name: format
props.description: How the value is formatted (a percentage by default).

props.name: variant
props.description: The indicator colour: running, or the outcome.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Names the bar when there is no label.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes, merged after the component's own.

slots.name: root
slots.description: role="progressbar"; data-slot="progress", data-variant, data-size, Base UI's data-progressing, data-complete, data-indeterminate.

slots.name: indicator
slots.description: The filled part, its width set by Base UI; data-slot="progress-indicator".

parts.name: ProgressLabel
parts.description: The task's name; Progress renders it from label.

parts.name: ProgressValue
parts.description: The formatted value; Progress renders it with showValue.

states.name: indeterminate
states.description: A third of the track slides across (still under reduced motion).

accessibility: role="progressbar" with aria-valuenow, aria-valuemin, aria-valuemax and a formatted aria-valuetext (getAriaValueText for units such as rows); no aria-valuenow while indeterminate.
label is the bar's accessible name (aria-labelledby); without one, pass aria-label.
The outcome is in the label text ("Export failed at row 180,224"), not only the indicator colour.
The width change and the indeterminate slide stop under prefers-reduced-motion.
